listener.note: the 16:14 listener predated the 19:27/21:07 owner trainings and held old weights in memory; stopped, the supervisor relaunched it on the new code

root_causes: VoiceSettings had no wake_sensitivity/volume fields; voice_settings() only set attributes that existed, so Save dropped both silently and the listener ran the manifest 0.7 while the form showed 0.55
wake_test divided int16 PCM by 32768 and ZeusDetector.feed cast the float back to int16 -> near-silence; the reported scores (0.000 ... 0.99 spikes) were noise unrelated to the settings
ZeusDetector.reset() kept _last_fire, so an offline evaluation through one detector suppressed every fire within 1.5 s real time of the previous clip (7/30 instead of 27/30)
training clips were padded with exact digital zeros; the model learnt 'sound then zero' as a cue and scored 0.99 on a silent recording at the zero-padding transition
the live listener was launched at 16:14 and never reloaded the model trained at 19:27
fixes: VoiceSettings models, validates and persists every field (data/jarvis/voice/settings.json); unknown keys are refused by name
one PCM contract (speech.wake_zeus.to_int16_frame) and one scorer (speech.wake_eval.score_wav) for test, evaluation and listener
resolve_threshold(owner, manifest, fallback): one effective threshold, reported with its source
reset() clears the cooldown; trainer adds a dither floor and skips silent owner recordings; evaluation pads with noise, never zeros
listener polls /api/voice/wake every 5 s, applies the effective threshold, hot-reloads a retrained model, reports fingerprint+threshold back
volume lives only in ui/voice/playback.js (audio.volume); VoiceSettings.WAKE_INPUTS excludes it (test pinned)
wake_word.hard_negatives: none recorded by the owner; not evaluated (synthetic voices are not reported as real-world acceptance)
wake_word.owner_acceptance: NOT CLAIMED: the final spoken 'Zeus' test at the microphone is the owner's

ambient_speech.gate: core.hear(): session (wake score or origin=ui) + fragment/trailing-off/low-confidence/duplicate rules; rejections are DIAGNOSTIC events, zero messages/receipts/missions
ambient_speech.listener: sends X-Jarvis-Wake/X-Jarvis-Session with each utterance; the UI microphone sends origin=ui

knowledge.root_cause: routes used state/knowledge/graph.db (empty) while the machinery wrote palace.sqlite (144 nodes); no knowledge.create/link primitive existed, so the planner substituted note.create
knowledge.fix: one graph (palace.sqlite) behind core.graph, legacy graph.db migrated once; knowledge.create/link/read primitives with read-back verification; /api/knowledge/create|link|read|backlinks|delete|stats

live.search 'PCM scaling': first hit 'Voice Studio PCM scaling defect'
live.persistence: 144 nodes/146 edges survived the core restart; stats afterwards 148 nodes/149 edges

planner.constraints: extract_constraints(): negations -> forbidden_actions, 'no fallback' -> forbids every producing primitive outside the required outcome; enforced in Composer.parse (status=forbidden, never run)
planner.roles: required/optional/alternative/verification; observations optional by default; optional failure continues; required failure -> one bounded replan
planner.goal: GoalEvaluation: ACTION_EXECUTED / EXECUTION_VERIFIED / GOAL_SATISFIED kept apart; COMPLETE only on GOAL_SATISFIED
planner.relevance: registry.find strips address terms (zeus, jarvis, ...) and demotes FAILING capabilities; single-capability calls build the payload from the input schema (no more {'goal': ...})

capabilities.health: manifest.health written by every execution (healthy/degraded/failing/unverified, persisted); doctor capability_health + Capability Center show it apart from status
capabilities.paths: runtime/paths.resolve_workspace_path: idempotent workspace prefix, no escapes, existence check before dispatch

expert.states: NOT_INSTALLED | INSTALLED | NOT_AUTHENTICATED | AUTHENTICATED | AVAILABLE | BUSY | QUOTA_EXHAUSTED | RATE_LIMITED | UNKNOWN | ERROR, cached 300 s, execution evidence outranks probes; no PAYG path

ui.headless_chrome_cdp_sweep: projects, missions, activity, knowledge, capabilities, diagnostics, voice, release: 0 console errors, 0 uncaught exceptions; every view mounted with live data
